sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.14 "EXTI external interrupt selection register (EXTI_EXTICR2)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 463.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x064
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
EXTI mux 4, 5, 6, 7
Bits 31:24 EXTI7[7:0]: EXTI7 GPIO port selection
These bits are written by software to select the source input for EXTI7 external interrupt.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV7 is disabled, EXTI7 can be accessed with privileged and
unprivileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV7 is enabled, EXTI7 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this bit is discarded.
